title: Design and implement Project Memory System v1
description: Implement a reusable repository-native PMS framework and evidence-based Lookaway project memory, then validate the structure, records, utilities, onboarding, and handoff.
assignee: AI agent with human project owner authority
acceptance_criteria: Separate reusable PMS framework from Lookaway-specific memory.
Document project context, verified state, architecture, requirements, roadmap, and learning plan.
Create accepted initial ADRs and indexed task records.
Implement offline JSON/JSONL validation and status, handoff, history, and search CLI commands.
Test schemas, negative cases, CLI behavior, non-destructive validation, fresh-agent onboarding, and recovery.
Preserve Lovable-managed AGENTS.md content and do not modify application implementation or dependency manifests.
test_requirements: Run Python standard-library unit tests for valid and invalid records, references, IDs, timestamps, indexes, handoff output/archive, and CLI commands.
Run memory validation and confirm it does not modify project files.
Attempt fresh-agent reconstruction from onboarding documentation without prior conversation context.
verification_evidence: At 2026-11-21T10:40:40Z, initial implementation testing passed 18 of 18 PMS tests.
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tools/pms/memory.py validate — passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
PMS-002 independently reran the suite and found 17 passes and 1 failure in the history test, which depended on the accumulated real repository history.
PMS-003 replaced the brittle assertion with controlled history fixtures and, in a pre-record reconciliation run, passed all 22 tests.
Final post-correction verification at 2026-11-21T11:43:04Z passed 22 of 22 PMS tests and PMS validation reported 0 errors and 0 warnings.
CLI tests execute status, validate, handoff, history, search, help, unsafe path rejection, and archive replacement from outside the repository working directory.
Validation non-destructive test confirms selected project files retain identical contents and modification times.
A separate fresh agent with no prior conversation reconstructed the project from repository onboarding instructions and identified two memory inconsistencies, which were reconciled.
